這是根據兩地經緯度計算的球面距離（Haversine 公式），實際行車距離會因航線、航路或飛行路徑而略有不同。

Compute difference: dlat = lat2-lat1 = 13.0°, dlon = lon2-lon1 = -244.1°. In radians: dlat=0.227 rad, dlon=-4.259 rad. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). sin(dlat/2)=sin(0.1135)=0.1133, squared=0.01284. cos(lat1)=cos(24.8°)=0.908, cos(lat2)=cos(37.8°)=0.788. sin(dlon/2)=sin(-2.1295)= -0.848, squared=0.719.
